title: File:Syaphru, Rasuwa.jpg
desc: Syaphru, a village at the confluence of Langtang Khola (top) and Bhote Khosi (left) to form Trishuli (right), in Rasuwa District in Nepal.

title: File:Hanging Bridge Langtang Trekking Rasuwa.jpg
desc: The hanging bridge is over the Langtang Khola, a tributary of the Trishuli River. It is a part of the Langtang Valley Trekking. The Langtang National Park, Nepal's first Himalayan national park, is situated in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Sindhuplachowk districts.
